title: Data-driven and physics-guided hindcasting of measured wave spectra
abstract: arXiv:2610.29306v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Short-range hindcasts of measured wave spectra are evaluated using a recurrent model initialized by one hourly buoy spectrum and supplied with local wind, fetch and depth. Measurements from three Baltic Sea stations are combined for training in 2017--2020, validation in 2021 and testing in 2022. ERA5 reanalysis supplies winds throughout the twelve-hour prediction interval. The comparison examines supervision of spectral variance, peak frequency and peak amplitude, followed by empirical wind-sea bounds and a local relaxation constraint. Variance and peak-frequency supervision gives the lowest spectral error within the data-driven comparison, whereas additional peak-amplitude supervision gives the lowest wave-height error. In the matched physical comparison, relaxation reduces height RMSE by 5.01\% to \PhPtwoHs{}~cm. translated_title: 数据驱动与物理引导的实测波浪谱后报
translated_abstract: 对实测波浪谱的短期后报进行了评估，所用循环模型由单个逐时浮标谱初始化，并输入当地风、风区和深度信息。来自波罗的海三个站点的观测数据被组合使用：2017–2020年用于训练，2021年用于验证，2022年用于测试。ERA5再分析资料在整个十二小时预测区间内提供风场。比较研究考察了谱方差、峰值频率和峰值振幅的监督方式，随后引入经验风浪边界和局部松弛约束。在数据驱动比较中，方差与峰值频率监督给出了最低的谱误差，而额外的峰值振幅监督给出了最低的波高误差。在匹配的物理比较中，松弛约束将波高RMSE降低了5.01%，降至约2厘米。将该约束扩展至第13–24小时（在这些小时没有谱目标的情况下），使主谱RMSE降低了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种数据驱动并结合物理约束的循环模型，利用浮标谱初始化并输入风、风区和深度信息，实现了对波罗的海实测波浪谱长达12小时的准确后报，其中物理松弛约束将波高RMSE降低5.01%至约2厘米。
en_tdlr: The study develops a data-driven, physics-guided recurrent model for short-range hindcasting of measured Baltic Sea wave spectra, demonstrating that a local relaxation constraint reduces wave-height RMSE by 5.01% to approximately 2 cm over a twelve-hour forecast interval.
